_comment: GitHub App manifest for the Conductor bot (issue #3) — the sole privileged trunk writer. Create it via Settings > Developer settings > GitHub Apps > New (or the create-from-manifest flow), install it on the target repo, then set the repo Actions variable CONDUCTOR_APP_ID and the secret CONDUCTOR_APP_PRIVATE_KEY. Least-privilege: only what the engine needs to land, check, and release.
